from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u048/system/state/workspace/programs')

code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    frames = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y+dy, x+dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            if not (all(grid[r0][x] == color and grid[r1][x] == color for x in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[y][c0] == color and grid[y][c1] == color for y in range(r0,r1+1))):
                continue
            pattern = [[grid[y][x] == color for x in range(c0+1,c1)] for y in range(r0+1,r1)]
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pattern))
    sources = [f for f in frames if any(any(row) for row in f[5])]
    if not sources:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The patterned rectangle is the template; copy its interior shape to
    # all other rectangular frames with the same interior dimensions.
    source = max(sources, key=lambda f: sum(sum(row) for row in f[5]))
    sh, sw = len(source[5]), len(source[5][0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pattern in frames:
        if (r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1) != (sh,sw):
            continue
        for dy in range(sh):
            for dx in range(sw):
                if pattern[dy][dx]:
                    out[r0+1+dy][c0+1+dx] = color
    return out
'''
